subject: [hw] opus-lead -> V41: two post-first-test fixes (abort UAF, power refs on failed open)
body: (a) ap/n2ap_venc.c close/open abort (~697-700, 745-747): the handler is swapped to ven_drop_handler and e freed at once, but the guest thread may still be inside ven_ipi_handler (WAIT_ISR up to 500 ms) and then writes e->irq_status/hw_error/power_refs -> heap corruption after the first timeout, hiding the real error. Fix: atomic in_handler counter around the body of ven_ipi_handler; after swapping, wait while it is non-zero (ven_sleep_ms(1), bounded ~1000 ms) before free. (b) ven_free(): `while (e->power_refs > 0) (void)ven_power_ref(e, 0);` before free, so a guest POWER_ON during a failed INIT does not leave VEN powered until daemon exit. Low priority for the first encode (no POWER_ON IPI in GCE mode), needed before VideoToolbox use. Keep your tests green; post DONE rev N.
